reviewItem.question: Does "f542ae51588405065557e8ede710a50042cf529e: fix: Revert \"split arrays in yaml to fix ambiguous collapse when array items have nested objects (#21064)\"" mean a change to protocol-behavior:argo-cd|name=split-arrays-in-yaml (removed)?

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 reverts the earlier change that split arrays in YAML to fix ambiguous collapse when array items have nested objects (#21064), so that array-splitting behavior is no longer present.
